text.en: Most clients express strong gratitude toward individual trainers such as Andy and Grace, describing them as patient, supportive, and knowledgeable handlers. Reviewers note that trainers offer helpful coaching during integration sessions, although one customer reported a negative interaction with ownership.

Several dog owners report dramatic improvements in obedience, leash manners, and general calmness after completing board-and-train programs. However, feedback is mixed due to a critical account describing behavioral issues, illness, and unmet expectations with an assigned protection dog.

Satisfied pet owners praise the regular weekly video updates demonstrating training milestones and responsive communication from office staff. Conversely, a dissatisfied client cited shifting timelines and difficult communication regarding contract commitments and billing disputes.

q.en: Does the academy provide video updates during board-and-train?

a.en: Yes, several clients mention receiving weekly video progress reports showing their dogs practicing specific obedience commands.

q.en: Are owner transition sessions included after training?

a.en: Yes, reviewers describe participating in multiple hands-on integration sessions to practice handler commands before taking their dogs home.

q.en: Does the facility train high-drive working breeds?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight specialized behavior and obedience work with working breeds like Belgian Malinois and German Shepherds.

q.en: Is there a surcharge for credit card payments?

a.en: Reviewers note that paying by credit card incurs an additional payment processing fee, while alternative payment methods are accepted.
